quotes.author: Taylor L.
quotes.text: Our family had the BEST fishing trip with Tony at Santa Barbara Sportfishing Charters! We caught fish, made amazing memories, and somehow ended up with a story that includes Tony literally saving our lives. So, you know… just your average relaxing day on the water.Tony was knowledgeable, hilarious, and absolutely incredible from start to finish. We cannot recommend him enough! Be sure to ask him about his “friends from Arizona” when you book. Trust us, it is a story worth hearing.Thanks again, Tony, for the fish, the laughs, and, most importantly, for keeping the Arizona crew alive!

Had an unreal time out on the water with this charter for our graduation trip. Tony was awesome, super helpful, and made the whole experience fun from start to finish. We ended up catching 50+ fish and were getting bites nonstop. Couldn’t have asked for a better way to celebrate with friends. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great time and an unforgettable fishing trip!read moreread less

This is my 3rd trip with Captain Tony. It was a blast as always. We caught the most fish ever. Captain Tony as usual took us to the nice spots and we kept reeling them in one after the other. We really enjoyed outselves once again and we will be back. Thanks a lot Captain Tony for another wonderful day on the water.read moreread less

Great Time today! Captain Tony was great with all of us, understanding of all of our special needs, and did his best to bring a great experience to all of us. We caught plenty of fish, and look forward to making fish tacos tomorrow. Highly recommend this one.read moreread less
